build.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/component_calibration.py build --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM --receipt G:/XLM/calib/common_pile_cal01/sample-receipt.json --receipt G:/XLM/calib/common_pile_cal02/sample-receipt.json

calibration-show.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/component_calibration.py show --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM

measurement-record.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_inventory.py record --source common_pile_prose --calibration G:/XLM/calib/calibration.json --measurement G:/XLM/calib/common_pile_prose/measurement.json

measurement-record-versioned.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_inventory.py record --source common_pile_prose --calibration G:\XLM\calib\calibration.common-pile-post.json --measurement G:/XLM/calib/common_pile_prose/measurement.json

estimate-versioned.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_inventory.py estimate --quotas recipes/mixtures/mix01_quotas_6b.yaml --calibration G:\XLM\calib\calibration.common-pile-post.json --output G:/XLM/calib/headroom_estimate.common-pile-post.json

evidence-show.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_source.py evidence show --sample-dir G:/XLM/calib/common_pile_cal01 --sample-dir G:/XLM/calib/common_pile_cal02 --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM

review-show.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_source.py review show --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM

estimate-with-auxiliary.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_inventory.py estimate --quotas recipes/mixtures/mix01_quotas_6b.yaml --calibration G:/XLM/calib/calibration.common-pile-post.json --output G:/XLM/calib/headroom_estimate.common-pile-post.json --auxiliary-source ifm_general --auxiliary-source ifm_planning

strategy-a-preview.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_source.py component-split preview --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM --input docs\implementation\evidence\COMMON-PILE-POST-CALIBRATION\strategy-a.input.json --operator PREVIEW_ONLY --rationale "Calibrated strategy A; no operator choice recorded"

strategy-b-preview.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_source.py component-split preview --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM --input docs\implementation\evidence\COMMON-PILE-POST-CALIBRATION\strategy-b.input.json --operator PREVIEW_ONLY --rationale "Calibrated strategy B; no operator choice recorded"

strategy-c-preview.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_source.py component-split preview --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM --input docs\implementation\evidence\COMMON-PILE-POST-CALIBRATION\strategy-c.input.json --operator PREVIEW_ONLY --rationale "Calibrated strategy C; no operator choice recorded"

bounds-preview.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_source.py component-bounds preview --source-key common_pile --data-root G:/XLM --input docs\implementation\evidence\COMMON-PILE-POST-CALIBRATION\bounds.input.json --operator PREVIEW_ONLY --rationale "Calibrated operating ceilings with explicit 2x rate/row/line margins; not whole-shard measured maxima"

estimate-final.command: uv run --offline --locked --no-sync --extra cpu --extra eval python scripts/mix01_inventory.py estimate --quotas recipes/mixtures/mix01_quotas_6b.yaml --calibration G:/XLM/calib/calibration.common-pile-post.json --output G:/XLM/calib/headroom_estimate.common-pile-post.json --auxiliary-source ifm_general --auxiliary-source ifm_planning
